findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Cho tệp cá nhân, mỗi ngày." above "0đ"; "Thêm tiện lợi cho công việc." above "99.000đ"; "Cho những nhu cầu nâng cao." above "199.000đ"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): ul.lp-hero-capabilities → linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(7, 24, 60, 0.91), rgba(14, 43, 75, 0.85)) | div.lp-feedback-window → radial-gradient(at 95% 115%, rgba(24, 93, 241, 0.216), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), linear-gradient(120deg, rgb(8, 2 | article.lp-price-card.lp-price-featured → linear-gradient(150deg, rgb(21, 36, 72), rgb(7, 26, 57))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 8 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.lp-button.lp-button-dark → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 5px 10px 0px | div.lp-feedback-portrait → rgba(148, 186, 255, 0.15) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.133) 0px 12px 35px 0p | div.lp-feedback-portrait → rgba(148, 186, 255, 0.15) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.133) 0px 12px 35px 0p
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
12 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.lp-header 1425px | ul 281px | ul 281px | ul 281px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 3 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 1 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 106 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 76px on the left, 120px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 1832px of nothing between: "Chọn tệp, nhập mật khẩu, lưu kết quả. Mọi thứ rõ r"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Tệp của bạn. Quyền quyết định của bạn." → 3 lines (8 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
